q: Ayesha is facing north. She turns right, then right again. Which direction is she facing?
e: Two right turns from north point south.

q: Bilal is facing east. He turns left, then left again. Which direction is he facing?
e: Two left turns from east point west.

q: Sara is facing south. She turns right. Which direction is she facing?
e: A right turn from south points west.

q: Hamza is facing west. He turns left. Which direction is he facing?
e: A left turn from west points south.

q: Nida faces north, turns left, then turns right. Which direction does she finally face?
e: A left turn followed by a right turn cancels out.

q: Omar faces east, turns right, then turns left. Which direction does he finally face?
e: A right turn followed by a left turn returns to the original direction.

q: Hina faces south and makes three right turns. Which direction is she facing?
e: From south: right→west, right→north, right→east.

q: Usman faces west and makes three left turns. Which direction is he facing?
e: From west: left→south, left→east, left→north.

q: Mariam faces north, turns right, then left, then left. Which direction is she facing?
e: North→east→north→west.

q: Ali faces east, turns left, then right, then right. Which direction is he facing?
e: East→north→east→south.

q: Zara faces south, turns left, then right, then left. Which direction is she facing?
e: South→east→south→east.

q: Danish faces west, turns right, then left, then right. Which direction is he facing?
e: West→north→west→north.

q: Fatima is facing north. After a half-turn, which direction is she facing?
e: A half-turn reverses direction.

q: Kamran is facing east. After a half-turn, which direction is he facing?
e: A half-turn reverses direction.

q: Rida is facing southwest. After a half-turn, which direction is she facing?
e: A half-turn points to the opposite compass direction.
